Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Off Calendar May-27-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Thomas M. Ray, Esq. appeared for plaintiff American Express Centurion Bank.
No appearance by defendant Lumsden Quan.
Default was entered against defendant on February 11, 2010.
Doe defendants were dismissed on February 11, 2010.
Order waiving witness appearance at default prove-up hearing was filed on May 2, 2010.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff American Express Centurion Bank, and against the Defaulted Defendant Lumsden Quan as follows:

Damages/Principal - $54,097.87.
Prejudgment Interest - $7,380.36.
Attorney Fees - $2,825.00.
Costs - $621.50, for a total judgment in the amount of $64,924.73.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
